You’re no longer asking * " Why is this happening to me?"* but * " What is Allah teaching me through this?"* - Hadiths like the Prophet’s (ﷺ) words— * "How wonderful is the affair of the believer! The Quran shapes * how you see the world*, so even when you’re not actively reading, its principles guide you subconsciously. > **"This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah."** (2:2) > — The Quran doesn’t just * give* guidance; it * cultivates* those who * receive* it. --- ### In short: **Yes, it changes everything**. - You move from **" What do I want?"** to ** " What does Allah want? What is truly just? What builds a better world?"** - You stop seeing " right and wrong" as abstract concepts and start seeing them as ** living, breathing realities**— because the Quran and Hadith aren’t just texts; they’re a ** conversation with the Divine** that rewires your heart. Keep doing what you’re doing. This is how faith becomes * lived*— not just believed. 🌟 * "And whoever Allah guides, none can mislead him; and whoever He leaves astray, none can guide him"* (39:3). You’re already on that path. Trust the process.
